desc:
You get 1 ✨FREE SKIP✨ if you join the group!

❗Big thanks to Albert/Flamingo for creating the characters used in the game!❗
❗And thanks to the creator of Escape Running Head❗

🏆When completing a level, a trophy will appear in level 1🏆

In this game you have to complete levels and beat bosses while Felipe and Felipa heads are chasing you. Can you survive Felipe?

Can you escape and survive the head? The Running Head?

👍Don't forget to like and favorite if you enjoy and want more levels!👍

🔊Main background theme: "Tokyovania" by SharaX
Some music from Undertale/Deltarune🔊
